QuestInfo.name: Fake Request
QuestInfo.0: Ask JM about the incident at the Hut in the Swamp.
QuestInfo.1: JM From tha Streetz wants you to warn Nella.
QuestInfo.2: Nella claimed the monsters were a harmless prank for getting in her way. Maybe you're getting in over your head with these two...

0.0: I know what's going on here. Nella and Matthias are up to something.
0.1: Go to Nella and tell her I won't sit here and take this! And tell her to look forward to what I got in store for her!

no.0: I'm in a bad mood. You sure you want to say no to me?

1.0: What's up? I don't have any jobs for you right now.

yes.0: Come on, JM! It was just a little prank, that's all! Don't worry about it.
yes.1: It was just a little prank, that's all! Don't worry about it.

npc.0: What're you waiting for? Tell Nella what's in store for her!
